display.purpose: Page titles and hero KPI numbers. Tight line-height (0.96), negative tracking (-0.03em to -0.04em).

body.purpose: Prose, table cells, descriptions, form labels. Default reading size at 14px.

caption.purpose: Secondary/supporting text next to body content — sub-labels, helper text, timestamps in prose form. 13px.

micro.purpose: The densest tier — compact table meta, inline counts, small pill/chip text. 11px.

label.purpose: Any numeric, tabular, or metadata value: currency, counts, IDs, timestamps, section kickers. Always mono, often uppercase.

shadows.name: card-hover-dark
shadows.purpose: Bento card hover state in dark mode — violet ring + ambient shadow + soft glow.

shadows.name: card-hover-light
shadows.purpose: Bento card hover state in light mode.

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Primary button resting shadow — violet, not neutral black.

shadows.name: button-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible ring for buttons whose overflow:hidden clips the default outline.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus glow, paired with a violet border-color shift.

shadows.name: slideover-panel
shadows.purpose: Directional shadow for a panel sliding in from the right over content.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Default easing for hovers, entrances, and lifts — a slightly overshooting spring, not a linear/ease-out fade.

motion.name: duration-fade-up
motion.purpose: Page-enter stagger — each direct child of a `.page-enter` container fades up with an increasing delay (0ms, 60ms, 120ms...).

motion.name: duration-shine-sweep
motion.purpose: The diagonal light-sweep across a primary button on hover (`.btn-shine`).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button that should draw the eye — gradient violet fill, shine sweep on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7C3AED 0%, #9B5CF6 100%); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 50%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(124,58,237,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,58,237,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: translateX(100%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.4), 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent, quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6E74A4; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #A78BFA; border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.3); background: rgba(124,58,237,0.06); }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: The base card/panel used throughout the app — flat at rest, lifts and glows on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #101525; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.12); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,58,237,0.12), 0 16px 40px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 24px -4px rgba(124,58,237,0.12); } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6E74A4; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #EEF0FF; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — subtle border, violet glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background: #161C30; color: #EEF0FF; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6E74A4; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,0.12); }

components.name: Status Badge — Success
components.description: The tint/border/text formula every status badge follows — this is the 'active' variant.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(52,211,153,0.1); border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.2); color: #34D399; }

components.name: Status Badge — Muted
components.description: The deliberately de-emphasized variant — churned clients and the entry-level pricing tier, same formula but slate-muted instead of a status hue.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-badge-muted { background: rgba(75,80,128,0.2); border-color: rgba(75,80,128,0.3); color: #9B9FB8; }

components.name: Data Table Row
components.description: Table row hover behavior — the quietest interaction in the system, a faint violet wash rather than a lift.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-table-row { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-table-row:hover { background: rgba(124,58,237,0.04); } .ds-table-row td { padding: 14px 20px; color: #8B90B4; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Left sidebar navigation link — quiet at rest, violet accent when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8B90B4; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #EEF0FF; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #A78BFA; background: rgba(124,58,237,0.1); }

narrative.overview: This is an internal operations tool, not a marketing surface. The visual language reflects that: a near-black, layered navy void that recedes rather than competes for attention, with a single electric-violet accent doing all the emphasis work. Everything else stays deliberately quiet so the violet reads as authority rather than decoration. The system is unapologetically dense: tables, KPI tiles, and status badges dominate, because the job is scanning numbers and pipeline state quickly, not being persuaded.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (electric violet) carries all emphasis; nothing else competes with it
Flat at rest, glow and lift only on interaction — depth is earned, not default
Full light/dark theming via CSS custom property overrides, not a separate light design
Mono type (JetBrains Mono) marks anything numeric, tabular, or metadata

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only hue used for emphasis. Status colors communicate state, never "act here."

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Any numeric, tabular, or identifier value renders in JetBrains Mono. Prose never does.

rules.name: The Earned-Depth Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow just for existing. A shadow always means this is currently being interacted with, or deliberately floating above the base layer.

dos: Do keep violet as the only accent hue anywhere in the product.
Do render numeric/tabular/ID content in JetBrains Mono; render prose in Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do keep cards, buttons, and rows flat at rest — shadows and glows only on interaction.
Do pair every status badge with the tint/border/text formula rather than a solid fill.
Do check text-tertiary against its background before reusing it — its values were deliberately raised to clear WCAG AA.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue for emphasis.
Don't give a card or button a resting drop shadow "for depth."
Don't use all-caps body text or oversized eyebrow-style labels outside the established .eyebrow pattern.
Don't treat scripts/zwane-invoice.html or the email templates in lib/email.ts as the design reference — they predate this system and carry known contrast/font-overuse issues.
